response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat) SELECT site_reference, insurance_status, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurance_status ASC NULLS LAST, site_reference ASC LIMIT 10;
